items.summary: Recommendation: reject the three proposed SEO queue changes and all new production work this cycle. Attribution is incomplete, telemetry is low-volume, no outcomes are proven, and prior implementation/routing attempts have failed. Retain only the existing Great American Lakes measurement gate and keep SearchWoot private. Decision question: approve waiting for the recorded measurement thresholds and attribution reconciliation before authorizing implementation?
